title: VooPoo Argus Z2 Pod Vape Kit
description: The Voopoo Argus Z2 Pod Vape Kit combines simplicity, great performance, and effortless portability in a streamlined, easy-to-use design that’s ideal for both MTL (mouth-to-lung) and RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) vaping styles. Perfect for vapers of all experience levels, the Argus Z2 offers a smooth and consistent vaping experience wrapped in a compact and stylish body. Powered by a robust 1500mAh built-in battery, the Argus Z2 delivers up to 20W of max output, ensuring reliable, all-day performance. The device charges quickly via USB-C fast charging, minimising downtime between sessions. A handy battery light indicator lets you keep track of power levels at a glance, while the optimised fixed airflow system ensures smooth and satisfying vapour production every time. The Argus Z2 is fully compatible with the Voopoo Argus Pod Family, including the top-fill Voopoo Argus replacement pods. Each pod features a 2ml capacity (TPD-compliant) and offers multiple resistance options to suit your vaping preferences, from rich, flavourful MTL draws to fuller RDL clouds. The included 0.7ohm top-fill pod is designed for an effortless refill experience while delivering rich, satisfying flavour from your favourite e-liquids, including Nicotine Salts and 50/50 blends. The Voopoo Argus Z2 Pod Vape Kit is a perfect choice for those who value simplicity and performance in a device that’s both stylish and portable. Pair your kit with a vape juice blend that delivers the perfect balance of flavour and performance. We recommend using Nic Salts , 50/50 or High PG E-Liquid With this kit. Please Note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
